description: Election Commission - Local Authority Election - 2025 Notice under Section 66(2) Elected Members List - Mannar District
reasoning: This gazette contains election results and declarations of elected members for local authorities (Mannar Urban Council, Mannar Pradeshiya Sabha, Nanattan Pradeshiya Sabha, and Musali Pradeshiya Sabha), published by the Election Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This fits the Elections category (Type 7) as it specifically deals with electoral processes, candidate declarations, and election outcomes.
